2017: Completely revamped copy, shifting from the 2016 focus on 'human potential' and '125-year history' to a punchy, emotionally resonant tagline: 'Abbott is in the business of life' and 'The power of health.' Length was shortened.
2018: Minor wording tweak in the disclaimer text ('country or countries' changed to 'country or region'), while the main body text remained identical to 2017.
2019: Added substantial concrete product details and use cases (diabetes fingersticks, heart monitors, chronic pain, blood donations) under a new 'Life-Changing Technology' heading, significantly increasing length and grounding the abstract tone in tangible medical impact.
2020: Dropped 'Our Anthem' header and paragraph, streamlining the structure while keeping the core 'Life-Changing Technology' and community messaging intact.
2021: Removed the cross-reference link disclaimer sentence about worldwide websites from the boilerplate text, slightly shortening the footer/disclaimer section.
2022: Expanded the text significantly by reintroducing the community-focused 'live fully' section from earlier years under a new heading ('At our healthiest, we can unlock all that life has to offer') and changed 'Life-changing technology' to 'Creating life-changing technology'. Also updated accessibility and exit warning language.
2024: Dropped the top headers ('About Abbott', 'Abbott is in the business of life', 'Who we are', 'Life-changing technology', and 'Life. To the fullest.'), starting directly with the product description paragraph and retaining the later additions.
